what: The walker of this folder (walker.mjs, installWalker) run by hand in the Claude desktop app's browser pane against PORT=5148 pnpm dev (solo), on 2026-11-15, after the last commit that changed the world's areas. Not produced by run.sh: headless Chromium has no graphics card, this browser does.
graphics: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M1 Max, Unspecified Version)
tour: spawn, three stops inside the clearing, east glade (62, 14), far clearing (64, 46), far corner (80, 57), south glade (18, 44), stone hollow (-26, 45): 8 legs, all arrived
reading: The screen refreshes every 8.3 ms. The frame in which a chunk is built or dropped comes after 11 to 21 ms, so at most one refresh is skipped; no frame of the walk took longer than 20.8 ms.
